registration: Local time-stamped hash freeze; not a public preregistration
study: Source-screened follow-up to archived Study B, which is now development/retrospective material

sample.reason_for_refinement: Before any C inference, fine-unit review showed broad count pairs mixed distances, ordinals, ranks and entity counts. Restrict the primary follow-up to 57 calendar-year pairs and 5 dated population pairs with established common units.
sample.development_exclusions: All 128 prior B test/donor IDs and all of their context titles excluded. Current A exact question/title overlap checked.
sample.candidate_frame: 192 fresh, globally title-disjoint candidates from the pinned HotpotQA validation snapshot
sample.source_audit: Individual assistant review of original questions and complete support bridges, with relevant context contradictions checked; 135 source-supported candidates, 38 exclusions and 19 unresolved cases. No human validation or universal external-world truth verification is implied.
sample.pair_rule: Within accepted calendar-year and population classes, sort by SHA256('rag-security-followup-v1:' + id), pair adjacent cases, first is test and second donor; use all 62 pairs sorted by their smaller selection hash.
sample.question_policy: Preserve original question text and reference; exclude unresolved cases rather than repair a question after model outputs.
sample.unit_scope: Calendar years and dated population counts; no claim of representative institutional workloads, official hidden HotpotQA test performance or pretraining independence
sample.eligible_units: 114 accepted calendar-year candidates and 11 accepted dated-population candidates after corrected unit review; adjacent pairs use all114years and the first10population cases in SHA order.

unpaired_reserve.reason: Last in the accepted population SHA order; no adjacent same-unit donor remains. Retained as an unused reserve, not excluded after outcomes.

research_questions.RQ1: Targeted versus unrelated and benign insertions under no defense, with question pairs, dose, designated value and 120-word insertion length fixed.
research_questions.RQ2: Supporting-evidence recovery and attack exposure in the full pipeline; separate five-passage controlled-context experiment with all required evidence retained.
research_questions.RQ3: Defense prevention, reference-value restoration and newly introduced failures; supplied-label rejection versus identical text with accepted labels.
research_questions.RQ4: Clean answer-format utility and separate retrieval-only sensitivity to rejecting a required legitimate support.

main_endpoint.automatic_primary: Strict concise target-choice proxy and designated numeric target production, reported as automatic outputs rather than completed semantic endorsement or factual attack-success judgments.
main_endpoint.human_semantic_endpoint: Required and pending actual independent initial review and source-linked adjudication; not replaced by automatic proxies or assistant source judgments.
main_endpoint.human_reviewers: Two other people to be arranged by the user; the user is coordinator, not a reviewer. Construction involvement and prior familiarity must be recorded. No judgments have yet been collected.

corpus_and_conditions.positive_contamination_share: 62/682 = 9.0909 percent; stress setting with all 62 targets covered
corpus_and_conditions.filter: Before retrieval, verified=True AND trust in {high,medium}; all clean items accepted, all base insertions rejected including benign. Accepted-label changes only the targeted insertion labels.
corpus_and_conditions.label_authority: Dataset constructor supplies experimental labels. No operational document authentication or institutional authority has been implemented.
corpus_and_conditions.retrieval: Frozen 1536-dimensional text-embedding-3-small vectors, normalized exact cosine, stable corpus-order ties, 30 candidates, TF-IDF reranking where enabled, 5 final passages.

controlled_exposure.fixed_context: Two complete canonical support passages and two canonical non-support passages are identical across arms. Replace one 120-word slot with the exact paired core insertion.
controlled_exposure.baseline_filler: Explicitly constructed neutral archival-index prose, not attributed to an external source; no query, reference value or target value. Exactly 120 whitespace words.
controlled_exposure.slot_policy: Pair hash-order index modulo five; same slot for all four arms and all rounds of each question
controlled_exposure.defenses: None in this module; exposure is imposed and all required evidence is retained.

dose_module.interpretation: Identical-text repetition at fixed target coverage, with distinct IDs and retained duplicate passages. Not a replay of the historical repetition archive.

generator.cache: Exact payload reused only within the same round; three fresh provider invocations per distinct payload across rounds.
generator.independence_limit: Fresh invocations do not guarantee statistically independent service samples. Rounds and condition rows do not increase the independent question count.
generator.model_fallback: Forbidden; stop on an unavailable or mismatched model.

analysis.aggregation: Mean within question across the three planned rounds, then across the 62 questions. Also report every round.
analysis.missingness: Preserve failed/truncated/unresolved outputs and report lower/upper rates with planned denominators; show paired-complete sensitivity analysis separately. Missing is not attack failure.
analysis.uncertainty: Main descriptive counts and per-round ranges; any resampling interval is explicitly conditional on the fixed corpus and question/support groups, not a population or new-corpus guarantee.
analysis.case_selection: Archive all predefined failure groups; choose illustrative cases by a stable hash rule, not effect favorability.
analysis.source_groups: Complete context titles and exact support statements are checked for overlap; remaining semantic/source-family dependence is a stated limitation.

execution_gates: Code and all effective source/data/evaluation definitions frozen before embedding dispatch.
Returned vectors and all final contexts/requests frozen before generation dispatch.
Every applicable hash checked before each dispatch, including empty caches and resumed runs.
Maximum three attempts per logical request across resumes; stop on permanent errors.
Conservative USD 5 ceiling; record token usage and retain reservations for attempts with unknown charge.

upper_bounds.count_policy: Actual unique request count is determined by the frozen payload hash census; embeddings and network retries are counted separately.
